name: com.patriacitizenship/citizenship
title: Patria Citizenship
description: Italian citizenship by descent: eligibility check, documents, cost and timeline, free case review.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Facts about Italian citizenship by descent as Patria Citizenship handles it: who qualifies, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, what we do, and the main pages.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Our public answers to common questions about Italian citizenship by descent (documents, travel, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, family situations). Pass the person's question to get the closest answers, or leave it empty for the full list.

question.description: The person's question in their own words (optional).

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Quick read of whether a family line qualifies for Italian citizenship by descent under the law after the 2025 reform: which generation the Italian-born ancestor is, and when they became a U.S. citizen, if ever. Gives the same preliminary read as the eligibility check on https://patriacitizenship.com/check, plus the facts still missing, anything that closes the route, and the first documents to gather. Ask the person for each answer; use "not_sure" when they don't know. The result is preliminary: our team confirms every case.

ancestor.description: Closest ancestor born in Italy: parent, grandparent, great_grandparent (or further back), or other (other / not sure).

natz.description: Did that Italian-born ancestor become a U.S. citizen, and when, relative to the birth of their child in the line (for a parent: the person; for a grandparent: the person's mom or dad)? never, after_child, before_child, or not_sure.

italy_residence.description: Only for a great-grandparent line: did the person's parent or grandparent ever live in Italy? yes, no, or not_sure.

tools.name: get_document_checklist
tools.description: The documents a Italian citizenship by descent case needs, as Patria Citizenship publishes them: civil records for the family line, proof of the ancestor's status, apostilles and translations, and who obtains what. Pass the ancestor's generation to see how many people in the line need records.

ancestor.description: Closest ancestor born in Italy: parent, grandparent, great_grandparent (or further back), or other (other / not sure).

tools.name: estimate_cost_timeline
tools.description: Patria Citizenship's published cost and timeline for a Italian citizenship by descent case: our fees, government fees and pass-through costs, and how long each stage takes. The exact quote follows the free eligibility review.

tools.name: find_records
tools.description: Where the records of a Italian ancestor are usually kept (archives, civil registries, naturalization records) and how they are obtained, as Patria Citizenship describes it.

tools.name: start_case
tools.description: Sends the person's details to Patria Citizenship for a free eligibility review, exactly like the form on https://patriacitizenship.com/check. We read the family line and reply by email; a confirmation email arrives shortly. Only call this after the person has clearly asked to send their details to Patria Citizenship, and set confirmed_by_person to true. Never guess an email address.

email.description: The email address where we should send the review.

family_story.description: What they know about their Italian ancestor and the family line: names, places, dates, when the family left, documents they have.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the person offers it.

ancestor.description: Closest ancestor born in Italy: parent, grandparent, great_grandparent (or further back), or other (other / not sure).

natz.description: Did that Italian-born ancestor become a U.S. citizen, and when, relative to the birth of their child in the line (for a parent: the person; for a grandparent: the person's mom or dad)? never, after_child, before_child, or not_sure.

italy_residence.description: Only for a great-grandparent line: did the person's parent or grandparent ever live in Italy? yes, no, or not_sure.

email_confirmed.description: Set to true only if we flagged the email as possibly mistyped and the person confirmed it is correct.

confirmed_by_person.description: True only when the person explicitly asked to send these details to Patria Citizenship.
